sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心思想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Today's episode contains violence against children.
sentences.zh: 本期节目包含针对儿童的暴力内容。

sentences.en: It won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 并非所有听众都适合收听。

sentences.en: The small rural property of Hinterkaifeck lay approximately 70 kilometres north of the German city of Munich.
sentences.zh: 辛特凯费克（Hinterkaifeck）是一处位于德国慕尼黑以北约70公里处的小型乡村房产。

sentences.en: Set against Bavaria's flat, sweeping farmlands, meadows and pine forests, the acreage earned
sentences.zh: 它坐落在巴伐利亚平坦广阔的农田、草地和松林之间，其非正式名称

sentences.en: its unofficial name from a nearby hamlet called Kaifeck, with Hinter being German for behind.
sentences.zh: 源自附近一个叫凯费克（Kaifeck）的小村庄，“Hinter”在德语中意为“后面”。

sentences.en: Built in 1863, the single-storey stone farmhouse was shaped like the letter L.
sentences.zh: 这座单层石砌农舍建于1863年，呈L型布局。

sentences.en: The living quarters occupied the longer portion of the building, while a barn, stables and engine room were at the other end.
sentences.zh: 建筑较长的一侧是生活区，另一端则是谷仓、马厩和机房。

sentences.en: Outside, the large yard featured a well, crop fields, livestock pastures and a tool shed that also functioned as a laundry room and bakery.
sentences.zh: 屋外的大院子里有一口水井、农田、牲畜牧场，还有一个兼作洗衣房和烘焙房的工具棚。

sentences.en: It was an isolated spot, the closest neighbour was half a kilometre away, and the nearest village was even further.
sentences.zh: 这是一个偏僻的地方，最近的邻居也在半公里之外，最近的村庄则更远。

sentences.en: In 1922, Hinterkaifeck was owned and operated by three generations of the Gruber-Gabrielle family, fronted by 63-year-old Andreas Gruber and his 72-year-old wife Cecilia.
sentences.zh: 1922年，辛特凯费克由格鲁伯-加布里埃尔（Gruber-Gabrielle）家族的三代人经营，户主是63岁的安德烈亚斯·格鲁伯（Andreas Gruber）和72岁的妻子塞西莉亚（Cecilia）。

sentences.en: Their 35-year-old daughter, Victoria Gabriel, also lived at the farmstead, along with her
sentences.zh: 他们35岁的女儿维多利亚·加布里埃尔（Victoria Gabriel）也住在这里，还有她的

sentences.en: two children, two-year-old Joseph and seven-year-old Cecilia, who was named after her grandmother, but went by the nickname Sealy.
sentences.zh: 两个孩子：两岁的约瑟夫（Joseph）和七岁的塞西莉亚（Cecilia）。后者以祖母的名字命名，但平时大家都叫她“西莉”（Sealy）。

sentences.en: Sealy attended primary school in the nearby municipality of Weidhofen, with classes scheduled six days a week, including Saturdays.
sentences.zh: 西莉在附近的魏德霍芬（Weidhofen）上小学，课程安排为每周六天，包括周六。

sentences.en: On Saturday, April 1, 1922, Sealy was absent from school.
sentences.zh: 1922年4月1日，星期六，西莉没有去学校。

sentences.en: It was not unusual, given she was prone to illness and was noticeably exhausted the day before.
sentences.zh: 这并不奇怪，因为她身体一向不好，而且前一天看起来明显精疲力竭。

sentences.en: Her teacher led the class in the Lord's Prayer to help Sealy recover, before moving on with their studies.
sentences.zh: 老师带领全班诵读了《主祷文》为西莉祈祷康复，随后继续上课。

sentences.en: Later that afternoon, two coffee merchants delivering an order to Hinterkaifeck noticed all of the doors on the property were locked, and nothing stirred within.
sentences.zh: 当天下午晚些时候，两名给辛特凯费克送货的咖啡商发现房产的所有门都锁着，里面毫无动静。

sentences.en: They could hear a dog barking from inside the stables, accompanied by the sounds of cattle.
sentences.zh: 他们能听到马厩里传来狗叫声，伴随着牛的叫声。

sentences.en: The merchants went up the road to a neighbouring property and informed the Schlittenbauer family that Hinterkaifeck appeared deserted.
sentences.zh: 商人们走到路边的邻居家，告诉施利滕鲍尔（Schlittenbauer）一家，辛特凯费克似乎空无一人。

sentences.en: Saturdays were typically busy for the Gruber-Gabrielle family, with members often sighted working around the farm.
sentences.zh: 周六通常是格鲁伯-加布里埃尔一家忙碌的日子，人们经常能看到他们在农场周围干活。

sentences.en: Yet, the pastures remained empty.
sentences.zh: 然而，牧场里却空空如也。

sentences.en: The next morning, two friends of the household waited by the front gate to meet Victoria Gabriel on their weekly walk to Sunday Mass.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，两位邻居在门前等候维多利亚·加布里埃尔，准备像往常一样结伴去参加周日弥撒。

sentences.en: She failed to appear, so the pair continued onwards without her.
sentences.zh: 她没有出现，于是两人只好独自前往。

sentences.en: Other passers-by were also beginning to notice the inactivity at Hinterkaifeck.
sentences.zh: 其他路人也开始注意到辛特凯费克的异常冷清。

sentences.en: When no one greeted the postman on Monday, he peered through the kitchen window expecting to see people bustling about, but the room was empty.
sentences.zh: 周一，当邮递员没见到人来取信时，他透过厨房窗户往里看，本以为会看到人们忙碌的身影，但房间里空无一人。

sentences.en: At 9am on Tuesday April 4, a mechanic arrived for a scheduled appointment to repair a diesel engine.
sentences.zh: 4月4日星期二上午9点，一名机械师按预约上门修理柴油发动机。

sentences.en: He, too, heard the cattle mooing and dog barking from within the stables, but his knocks to the front door went unanswered, and there was no smoke coming from the chimney.
sentences.zh: 他也听到了马厩里传来的牛叫声和狗叫声，但他敲前门却无人应答，烟囱里也没有冒烟。

sentences.en: Thinking the family must have stepped out, he went to inspect the engine room and noticed the lock was broken and easily removable.
sentences.zh: 他以为这家人出门了，便去检查机房，发现锁坏了，很容易就能打开。

sentences.en: He carried the engine to the tool shed and spent the next four and a half hours fixing it.
sentences.zh: 他把发动机搬到工具棚，花了四个半小时进行修理。

sentences.en: Afterwards, as he walked across the courtyard, he noticed the previously locked door to the
sentences.zh: 事后，当他穿过庭院时，注意到之前锁着的

sentences.en: barn was now wide open and the family's pet, a German Spitz watchdog, had been removed from the stables and was now tied up by the front door, snarling.
sentences.zh: 谷仓门现在大开着，家里养的德国狐狸犬被从马厩里牵了出来，拴在前门边，正对着他咆哮。

sentences.en: The mechanic assumed someone had since returned home, but was confused as to why they hadn't approached him.
sentences.zh: 机械师以为有人回来了，但很困惑为什么他们没有过来找他。

sentences.en: He, too, visited the neighbouring Schlittenbauer residents to report on Hinterkaifeck's unusual stillness.
sentences.zh: 他也去拜访了邻居施利滕鲍尔家，报告了辛特凯费克不同寻常的寂静。

sentences.en: Concerned for the family, 48-year-old Lorenz Schlittenbauer sent his two young sons to check if anyone was home.
sentences.zh: 48岁的洛伦兹·施利滕鲍尔（Lorenz Schlittenbauer）担心这家人，便派他两个年幼的儿子去看看家里是否有人。

sentences.en: They found the entire farmhouse locked, with no lights on inside.
sentences.zh: 他们发现整个农舍都锁着，里面没有开灯。

sentences.en: All was silent, except for the cattle's loud, frantic-sounding mooing.
sentences.zh: 四周一片死寂，只有牛群发出响亮而焦躁的叫声。

sentences.en: Cecilia had inherited Hinterkaifeck at age 35, following the death of her first husband in
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚在35岁时继承了辛特凯费克，此前她的第一任丈夫在

sentences.en: 1885, with whom she had two children.
sentences.zh: 1885年去世，她与他育有两个孩子。

sentences.en: The following year, she married the property's farmhand, 27-year-old Andreas Gruber.
sentences.zh: 第二年，她嫁给了农场的雇工，27岁的安德烈亚斯·格鲁伯。

sentences.en: Generally viewed as helpful, Andreas was willing to lend a hand on his neighbour's farms, but was otherwise a socially withdrawn person.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚斯通常被认为很乐于助人，愿意帮邻居干农活，但在其他方面是个性格孤僻的人。

sentences.en: He and Cecilia had three daughters, yet only their firstborn, Victoria, survived infancy.
sentences.zh: 他和塞西莉亚生了三个女儿，但只有长女维多利亚活过了婴儿期。

sentences.en: The Gruber's were a private family who rarely interacted with others.
sentences.zh: 格鲁伯一家非常注重隐私，很少与他人往来。

sentences.en: Gossip dictated Andreas beat his wife and that his two deceased children had passed away from mistreatment and starvation.
sentences.zh: 坊间传言安德烈亚斯经常殴打妻子，而他那两个夭折的孩子是因为受虐待和饥饿而死。

sentences.en: Unsavoury rumours about Andreas' unsettling relationship with his daughter Victoria gained validity when
sentences.zh: 关于安德烈亚斯与女儿维多利亚之间令人不安的关系的传闻，在

sentences.en: at age 16, she admitted to a neighbour that her father was forcing himself on her and she could not bear the sight of him.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚16岁时向邻居承认父亲强迫她发生关系，且她无法忍受看到父亲时，得到了证实。

sentences.en: Cecilia's two children from her previous marriage eventually moved out of Hinterkaifeck, leaving Victoria behind.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚与前夫所生的两个孩子最终搬离了辛特凯费克，只留下了维多利亚。

sentences.en: Tall, slim and strong, Victoria did more than her fair share of labour on the farm.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚身材高挑、苗条且强壮，在农场承担了远超她份额的劳动。

sentences.en: She had a serious disposition, but was the most social member of her family, performing as a leading member of the church choir and attending mass every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 她性格严肃，却是家里最善于社交的人，不仅是教堂唱诗班的骨干，每周日还会参加弥撒。

sentences.en: By the time she turned 27, Victoria was engaged to a man named Carl Gabriel and the pair were married in April of 1914.
sentences.zh: 27岁时，维多利亚与一个名叫卡尔·加布里埃尔（Carl Gabriel）的男人订婚，两人于1914年4月结婚。

sentences.en: Following their union, Victoria and Carl were granted the deed to Hinterkaifeck.
sentences.zh: 婚后，维多利亚和卡尔获得了辛特凯费克的房产契约。

sentences.en: Andreas and Cecilia remained living at the property and working on the land.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚斯和塞西莉亚继续住在那里，并在土地上劳作。

sentences.en: Married life was fraught for the newlyweds, primarily due to Andreas' dislike of his son-in-law.
sentences.zh: 这对新婚夫妇的生活充满了摩擦，主要是因为安德烈亚斯不喜欢他的女婿。

sentences.en: Carl complained to friends that Andreas bullied and tormented him, sometimes by depriving him of meals.
sentences.zh: 卡尔曾向朋友抱怨安德烈亚斯欺负和折磨他，有时甚至不让他吃饭。

sentences.en: He returned to his parents' home a few weeks after the wedding, but they insisted he make the relationship work.
sentences.zh: 婚后几周，他回到了父母家，但父母坚持要他维持这段婚姻。

sentences.en: As Victoria was the Gruber's only child, ownership of Hinterkaifeck would eventually pass to the
sentences.zh: 由于维多利亚是格鲁伯家唯一的孩子，辛特凯费克的所有权最终会转给

sentences.en: Gabriel family, should the couple have children.
sentences.zh: 加布里埃尔家族，前提是这对夫妇有孩子。

sentences.en: Less than four months into their marriage, Carl enlisted to fight in World War I.
sentences.zh: 婚后不到四个月，卡尔应征入伍参加第一次世界大战。

sentences.en: When he left for the front lines in France, Victoria was pregnant with their first child.
sentences.zh: 当他前往法国前线时，维多利亚正怀着他们的第一个孩子。

sentences.en: Carl was killed in action before the year's end, and his daughter, Celie, was born one month later.
sentences.zh: 卡尔在年底前阵亡，一个月后，他们的女儿西莉出生了。

sentences.en: Three quarters of Carl's land title passed to his newborn, and the remainder went to his widow, making Victoria the sole adult owner of Hinterkaifeck.
sentences.zh: 卡尔四分之三的土地所有权传给了他的新生儿，其余部分归他的遗孀所有，这使维多利亚成为辛特凯费克唯一的成年所有者。

sentences.en: Six months after Carl's death, Victoria and her father Andreas were convicted of having an incestuous relationship.
sentences.zh: 卡尔去世六个月后，维多利亚和她的父亲安德烈亚斯因乱伦关系被定罪。

sentences.en: The charges related to crimes occurring between 1907 and 1910, when Andreas was aged in his early
sentences.zh: 指控涉及1907年至1910年间发生的罪行，当时安德烈亚斯年约

sentences.en: 50s and Victoria in her early 20s.
sentences.zh: 50出头，维多利亚20岁出头。

sentences.en: Victoria received a one-month prison sentence, and Andreas one year.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚被判入狱一个月，安德烈亚斯被判一年。

sentences.en: Both returned to Hinterkaifeck upon their release, and the family resumed their reclusive existence.
sentences.zh: 两人出狱后都回到了辛特凯费克，一家人恢复了隐居的生活。

sentences.en: In September 1919, Victoria gave birth to her second child, Joseph.
sentences.zh: 1919年9月，维多利亚生下了第二个孩子约瑟夫。

sentences.en: The birth certificate listed the initials LS as Joseph's father, which correlated with a brief
sentences.zh: 出生证明上将缩写“LS”列为约瑟夫的父亲，这与维多利亚一年前与

sentences.en: relationship Victoria had a year prior with her widowed neighbour, Lorenz Schlittenbauer.
sentences.zh: 鳏夫邻居洛伦兹·施利滕鲍尔之间的一段短暂关系相吻合。

sentences.en: Regardless, townsfolk suspected the child was a product of Victoria's incestuous relationship with her father.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，镇上的人还是怀疑这个孩子是维多利亚与她父亲乱伦的产物。

sentences.en: The 1920s were a time of political and social upheaval for Bavarians impacted by World War I, but the residents of Hinterkaifeck found themselves in a stable financial position.
sentences.zh: 20世纪20年代，受一战影响的巴伐利亚人经历了政治和社会动荡，但辛特凯费克的居民却处于稳定的经济地位。

sentences.en: The family of five were well-off tending crops and raising cows, oxen, piglets and chickens, although they had a reputation for being stingy with money.
sentences.zh: 这五口之家靠种植庄稼和饲养奶牛、公牛、猪仔和鸡过着富足的生活，尽管他们以吝啬著称。

sentences.en: In November 1920, the family hired 23-year-old Crescence Riga as their live-in maid.
sentences.zh: 1920年11月，这家人雇佣了23岁的克雷森斯·里加（Crescence Riga）作为住家女佣。

sentences.en: While at the farm, Crescence overheard Andreas order his daughter not to remarry, as he would be hers as long as he lived.
sentences.zh: 在农场期间，克雷森斯曾无意中听到安德烈亚斯命令女儿不得再婚，因为只要他活着，她就是他的。

sentences.en: Andreas once kept Victoria locked in a closet when a suitor arrived to ask for her hand in marriage.
sentences.zh: 有一次，当有追求者上门求婚时，安德烈亚斯竟把维多利亚锁在壁橱里。

sentences.en: Then, in late 1921, Crescence entered the barn and witnessed Andreas and Victoria engaged in sexual activity.
sentences.zh: 后来在1921年底，克雷森斯走进谷仓，目睹了安德烈亚斯和维多利亚正在进行性行为。

sentences.en: Victoria later explained that if she had known Crescence was about to enter, she, quote, would not have surrendered to her father.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚后来解释说，如果她知道克雷森斯要进来，她“绝不会屈从于父亲”。

sentences.en: Crescence resigned ten months into her employment, and the family began searching for a replacement.
sentences.zh: 克雷森斯工作十个月后辞职，这家人开始寻找替代者。

sentences.en: The following year, in March of 1922, Hinterkaifeck was disturbed by a series of strange events.
sentences.zh: 次年，即1922年3月，辛特凯费克发生了一系列奇怪的事件。

sentences.en: First, a set of house keys went missing.
sentences.zh: 首先，一套房门钥匙不见了。

sentences.en: Then, a Munich-based newspaper was found on the property.
sentences.zh: 接着，人们在房产内发现了一份慕尼黑的报纸。

sentences.en: No one in the area subscribed to the publication, or had recently travelled that far.
sentences.zh: 当地没人订阅这份报纸，也没有人最近去过那么远的地方。

sentences.en: Andreas queried the postman, but he had no idea how it got there.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚斯询问了邮递员，但他也不知道报纸是怎么来的。

sentences.en: On the morning of Thursday March 30, Andreas noticed the padlock on the engine room door was broken.
sentences.zh: 3月30日星期四早上，安德烈亚斯发现机房门上的挂锁坏了。

sentences.en: Nothing appeared to be missing, but snow had been tracked inside, indicating someone had entered.
sentences.zh: 看起来什么都没丢，但雪地上留下了痕迹，表明有人进入过。

sentences.en: He noticed two sets of footprints in the snow heading from the rear fields to his farmstead.
sentences.zh: 他注意到雪地里有两行脚印，从后方的田野一直延伸到他的农舍。

sentences.en: But, there were no tracks leading away.
sentences.zh: 但是，却没有离开的脚印。

sentences.en: Andreas encountered his neighbour, Lorenz Schlittenbauer, out in the fields, and mentioned the break-in, footprints, and missing keys.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚斯在田间遇到了邻居洛伦兹·施利滕鲍尔，提到了闯入事件、脚印和丢失的钥匙。

sentences.en: Lorenz hadn't noticed anything suspicious, but offered to contact police and lend Andreas his revolver for protection.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹没发现什么可疑之处，但提出可以联系警察，并把他的左轮手枪借给安德烈亚斯防身。

sentences.en: Andreas refused.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚斯拒绝了。

sentences.en: He didn't want police in his home, and felt capable of defending himself.
sentences.zh: 他不想让警察进屋，并觉得自己有能力保护自己。

sentences.en: Later, Andreas ran into a different neighbour, expressing his belief that rogues were inside his house.
sentences.zh: 后来，安德烈亚斯又遇到了另一位邻居，表达了他认为家里有歹徒的看法。

sentences.en: Andreas rejected his neighbour's invitation to search the property, claiming he was not afraid.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚斯拒绝了邻居帮忙搜查房产的提议，声称他不害怕。

sentences.en: When he returned home later, he noticed a cow was loose from the stables and running around in the yard.
sentences.zh: 当他后来回到家时，发现一头牛从马厩里跑了出来，在院子里乱跑。

sentences.en: That same day, Victoria Gabriel was out looking for a new maid.
sentences.zh: 同一天，维多利亚·加布里埃尔出门寻找新女佣。

sentences.en: She visited a woman named Francisca to enquire whether her sister, 45-year-old Maria Baumgartner, would be interested in the role.
sentences.zh: 她拜访了一位名叫弗朗西斯卡（Francisca）的妇女，询问她的妹妹、45岁的玛丽亚·鲍姆加特纳（Maria Baumgartner）是否有意担任此职。

sentences.en: Maria was a deeply religious and introverted woman who had worked as a maid since her mother's death in 1904.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚是一位虔诚且内向的女性，自1904年母亲去世后就一直做女佣。

sentences.en: She often encountered discrimination due to her slight intellectual disability and a birth defect that left one leg significantly shorter than the other.
sentences.zh: 她常因轻微的智力障碍和一条腿明显短于另一条腿的先天缺陷而受到歧视。

sentences.en: As such, Francisca graciously accepted the Hinterkaifec job on behalf of her older sister, with Maria scheduled to arrive to the farm the following day.
sentences.zh: 因此，弗朗西斯卡欣然替妹妹接受了辛特凯费克的工作，玛丽亚定于第二天到达农场。

sentences.en: That evening, as members of the Gruber-Gabriel family lay in their respective beds, they heard muffled footsteps pacing the attic above.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，当格鲁伯-加布里埃尔一家躺在各自的床上时，他们听到了楼上阁楼里传来沉闷的踱步声。

sentences.en: Armed with a torch, Andreas made his way upstairs to investigate, but only found large amounts of straw scattered across the floor.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚斯拿着手电筒上楼查看，却只发现地板上散落着大量的稻草。

sentences.en: At school the following morning of Friday March 31, seven-year-old Celie Gabriel was noticeably exhausted and fell asleep in class.
sentences.zh: 次日即3月31日星期五早上，七岁的西莉·加布里埃尔在学校里明显精疲力竭，并在课堂上睡着了。

sentences.en: The teacher woke her and asked if something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 老师叫醒她，问她是不是出了什么事。

sentences.en: Celie made no mention of the attic noises the night prior.
sentences.zh: 西莉没有提到前一天晚上阁楼里的噪音。

sentences.en: Instead, she said her family had spent the night searching for her mother, who had run into the woods after a violent altercation with Andreas.
sentences.zh: 相反，她说她家人昨晚一直在找她母亲，因为她母亲在与安德烈亚斯发生激烈争吵后跑进了树林。

sentences.en: Fears that Victoria had drowned in a nearby river subsided at daybreak, when she was discovered sitting on a tree stump.
sentences.zh: 人们担心维多利亚溺死在附近河里的恐惧在天亮时消散了，因为她被发现正坐在树桩上。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, at Hinterkaifec, Andreas conducted another thorough search of the farmhouse, but was unable to determine the source of the noises the night before.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在辛特凯费克，安德烈亚斯对农舍进行了另一次彻底搜查，但无法确定前一天晚上噪音的来源。

sentences.en: He and Victoria left the farm in the afternoon to complete several errands in the nearby town of Schraubenhausen.
sentences.zh: 下午，他和维多利亚离开农场，去附近的施劳本豪森（Schraubenhausen）镇办些杂事。

sentences.en: While there, Andreas told a hardware store clerk about the troubles on his farm, adding, quote,
sentences.zh: 在那里，安德烈亚斯向五金店店员讲述了农场的麻烦，并补充说，引用原话：

sentences.en: I am not afraid.
sentences.zh: “我不害怕。”

sentences.en: I have already prepared my rifle.
sentences.zh: “我已经准备好了我的步枪。”

sentences.en: Victoria mentioned the unsettling events to another shopkeeper, expressing fear that somebody was determined to break into their property.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚向另一位店主提到了这些令人不安的事件，表达了对有人蓄意闯入他们房产的恐惧。

sentences.en: At five o'clock that afternoon, Maria Baumgartner arrived to Hinterkaifec, a school of the escorted by her sister, Francisca.
sentences.zh: 当天下午五点，玛丽亚·鲍姆加特纳在姐姐弗朗西斯卡的陪同下抵达了辛特凯费克。

sentences.en: Cecilia and young Joseph were the only family members home at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时家里只有塞西莉亚和年幼的约瑟夫。

sentences.en: Maria was led to the maids' quarters tucked away off the kitchen, where she'd reside throughout her employment.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚被带到厨房旁边的女佣房，她将在那里度过她的工作时光。

sentences.en: Francisca stayed to help Maria get settled, but was eager to return home before dark.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯卡留下来帮玛丽亚安顿，但急于在天黑前回家。

sentences.en: Though it was spring, the snowy weather had been remarkably cold, and storms were anticipated for later that night.
sentences.zh: 虽然已是春天，但下雪的天气异常寒冷，预计当晚会有风暴。

sentences.en: Francisca farewelled her sister and exited the house.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯卡与妹妹告别后离开了房子。

sentences.en: Francisca sensed Hinterkaifec was an eerily lonely place.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯卡感觉到辛特凯费克是一个令人毛骨悚然的孤独之地。

sentences.en: As she approached the dirt road, she turned to see Maria running towards her.
sentences.zh: 当她走近土路时，回头看到玛丽亚正朝她跑来。

sentences.en: Maria hugged her sister firmly, wanting to say goodbye again.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚紧紧拥抱了姐姐，想要再次道别。

sentences.en: Francisca wasn't particularly close to her siblings, but she returned to the odd embrace and promised to visit again soon.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯卡与姐妹们并不亲近，但她还是回应了这个奇怪的拥抱，并承诺很快会再来看她。

sentences.en: It was over the weekend that Hinterkaifec fell unusually quiet.
sentences.zh: 就在那个周末，辛特凯费克变得异常安静。

sentences.en: Celie failed to show up for her Saturday school class, and the remainder of the family were absent from the fields.
sentences.zh: 西莉没去上周六的课，家里其他人也没有出现在田间。

sentences.en: The house was locked up and lifeless, with the only sounds coming from the animals secured inside the stable.
sentences.zh: 房子锁着，毫无生气，唯一的声音来自关在马厩里的动物。

sentences.en: On Tuesday April 4, Lorenz Schlittenbauer and his two young sons collected two other neighbours,
sentences.zh: 4月4日星期二，洛伦兹·施利滕鲍尔和他的两个小儿子叫上了另外两位邻居，

sentences.en: Jacob Ziegel and Michael Pell, and headed to Hinterkaifec, concerned that Andreas Gruber may have taken his own life.
sentences.zh: 雅各布·齐格尔（Jacob Ziegel）和迈克尔·佩尔（Michael Pell），前往辛特凯费克，担心安德烈亚斯·格鲁伯可能自杀了。

sentences.en: They arrived at around 5pm to discover all the animals were secured away, and the doors to the building were all locked, except for the one to the engine room.
sentences.zh: 他们在大约下午5点到达，发现所有的动物都被关好了，建筑的所有门都锁着，只有机房的门除外。

sentences.en: Inside, the group attempted to open a second interior door that led into the barn, but a wooden beam had been propped up on the other side, preventing entry.
sentences.zh: 在里面，一行人试图打开通往谷仓的第二道内门，但另一侧被一根木梁顶住了，无法进入。

sentences.en: After some heavy pushing, the beam gave way, and the men entered the dim barn with flashlights in hand.
sentences.zh: 用力推了几下后，木梁松动了，男人们拿着手电筒走进了昏暗的谷仓。

sentences.en: One of the stables was open and a cow had broken loose from its pen.
sentences.zh: 其中一个马厩开着，一头牛从围栏里跑了出来。

sentences.en: Lorenz climbed over a board, slipping on some hay as he went.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹翻过一块木板，走的时候在干草上滑了一下。

sentences.en: Behind him, Michael shuffled his way through the dark.
sentences.zh: 在他身后，迈克尔在黑暗中摸索着前进。

sentences.en: Suddenly, he yelled out,
sentences.zh: 突然，他大喊道：

sentences.en: There's a foot!
sentences.zh: “有一只脚！”

sentences.en: Lorenz looked down and saw a foot sticking out from a bale of hay.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹低头一看，发现一只脚从干草堆里伸了出来。

sentences.en: He pulled it towards him, uncovering the body of Andreas Gruber, dressed in trousers and an undershirt.
sentences.zh: 他把它拉向自己，露出了安德烈亚斯·格鲁伯的尸体，他穿着裤子和内衣。

sentences.en: His face was covered in blood and he had suffered significant head injuries.
sentences.zh: 他的脸满是血迹，头部受了重伤。

sentences.en: Lorenz could see three more bodies partially concealed under the straw.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹看到还有三具尸体部分隐藏在稻草下。

sentences.en: Jacob and Michael staggered out of the barn in shock, but Lorenz remained behind and inspected
sentences.zh: 雅各布和迈克尔震惊地踉跄着走出谷仓，但洛伦兹留了下来，检查了

sentences.en: the three other corpses, finding Cecilia, Victoria, and Celie with severe head wounds.
sentences.zh: 另外三具尸体，发现塞西莉亚、维多利亚和西莉头部都有严重的伤口。

sentences.en: Both Cecilia and Victoria were fully dressed and Celie wore her nightgown.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚和维多利亚都穿着整齐，西莉穿着睡袍。

sentences.en: Lorenz dragged the seven-year-old towards a wall where the lighting was better.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹把七岁的西莉拖到光线较好的墙边。

sentences.en: Jacob returned and asked him to stop and wait for the police, but Lorenz replied,
sentences.zh: 雅各布回来叫他停下，等警察来，但洛伦兹回答说：

sentences.en: I'm looking for my son.
sentences.zh: 我在找我的儿子。

sentences.en: Two-year-old Joseph was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 两岁的约瑟夫不见踪影。

sentences.en: Lorenz proceeded towards the adjoining stables, noticing a pickaxe leaning against the wall.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹走向相邻的马厩，注意到一把鹤嘴锄靠在墙边。

sentences.en: The family dog was tied up inside, despite the mechanic having seen it restrained by the front door only hours earlier.
sentences.zh: 家里的狗被拴在里面，尽管机械师几个小时前才看到它被拴在前门。

sentences.en: The dog had a wound above its right eye and recoiled and shook when the men approached.
sentences.zh: 狗的右眼上方有伤，当男人们靠近时，它畏缩并颤抖着。

sentences.en: The cattle were making a lot of noise, prompting Lorenz to water Jacob to throw them some hay.
sentences.zh: 牛群发出很大的噪音，促使洛伦兹去给雅各布喂水，顺便给它们扔些干草。

sentences.en: Lorenz continued to the door which connected the stables to the living quarters, finding it unlocked.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹继续走向连接马厩和起居区的门，发现门没锁。

sentences.en: He entered the kitchen and searched the house, finding Joseph Stroller in a bedroom with a woman's skirt draped over the top.
sentences.zh: 他走进厨房并搜查了房子，在卧室里发现了约瑟夫·斯托勒，上面盖着一件女式裙子。

sentences.en: Lorenz pulled the skirt aside and saw the toddler, quote, with his head shattered.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹拉开裙子，看到那个蹒跚学步的孩子，引用原话，“头部粉碎”。

sentences.en: He then unlocked a rear door to let Jacob and Michael in.
sentences.zh: 随后他打开后门，让雅各布和迈克尔进来。

sentences.en: Jacob questioned where he had gotten the key from, to which Lorenz responded it had been in the lock.
sentences.zh: 雅各布问他从哪弄到的钥匙，洛伦兹回答说钥匙一直插在锁上。

sentences.en: In the maid's quarters, a mattress had been pulled from the bed frame onto the floor.
sentences.zh: 在女佣的房间里，床垫从床架上被拉到了地板上。

sentences.en: Two feet poked out from under a checked duvet on top, one wearing a shoe and the other bare.
sentences.zh: 两条腿从上面的格子被子下伸出来，一只脚穿着鞋，另一只光着。

sentences.en: Lorenz removed the blanket and revealed the body of Hinterkaifeck's recently hired maid,
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹掀开毯子，露出了辛特凯菲克刚雇佣的女佣的尸体，

sentences.en: Maria Baumgartner, who had also endured a horrific attack.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚·鲍姆加特纳，她也遭受了可怕的袭击。

sentences.en: Jacob and Michael rushed to the nearby village of Groban to raise the alarm.
sentences.zh: 雅各布和迈克尔冲向附近的格罗班村报警。

sentences.en: Lorenz asked one of his sons to inform the local mayor while he stayed behind to look after the livestock.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹让他的一个儿子去通知当地镇长，而他则留下来照看牲畜。

sentences.en: The mayor notified nearby authorities and placed a call to the police chief in Munich.
sentences.zh: 镇长通知了附近的当局，并给慕尼黑的警察局长打了电话。

sentences.en: News of the gruesome massacre spread quickly and by 6pm a crowd had gathered at Hinterkaifeck.
sentences.zh: 这起骇人听闻的屠杀消息迅速传开，到下午6点，辛特凯菲克已经聚集了一群人。

sentences.en: As authorities had yet to arrive, a notably calm Lorenz took it upon himself to escort visitors through the property, pointing out the bodies as they went.
sentences.zh: 由于当局尚未到达，表现得异常冷静的洛伦兹自告奋勇带领访客参观房产，并沿途指出尸体的位置。

sentences.en: One neighbour cautioned him against allowing anyone else in, in case they disturbed the crime scene,
sentences.zh: 一位邻居告诫他不要再让任何人进入，以免破坏犯罪现场，

sentences.en: but Lorenz replied that they were already there and there was nothing he could do about it.
sentences.zh: 但洛伦兹回答说他们已经在里面了，他对此无能为力。

sentences.en: More people traipsed through the building, with one guest reportedly pausing in the kitchen to fix themselves a snack.
sentences.zh: 更多的人在建筑内走来走去，据报道，其中一位客人还在厨房停下来给自己准备零食。

sentences.en: Five investigators were dispatched from Munich along with two tracker dogs, but a slow journey meant they didn't arrive until 1.30am.
sentences.zh: 五名调查人员和两只追踪犬从慕尼黑被派往现场，但由于行程缓慢，他们直到凌晨1点30分才到达。

sentences.en: As it was too dark for them to inspect the crime scene, they rested at the mayor's home until first light.
sentences.zh: 由于天太黑无法检查犯罪现场，他们在镇长家休息直到天亮。

sentences.en: They arrived to Hinterkaifeck at 5.30 the following morning, where they found Lorenz Schlittenbauer still watching over the farm.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上5点30分，他们到达辛特凯菲克，发现洛伦兹·施利滕鲍尔仍在看守农场。

sentences.en: Lead investigator,
sentences.zh: 首席调查员，

sentences.en: Detective George Reingruber entered the barn.
sentences.zh: 乔治·莱因格鲁伯侦探进入了谷仓。

sentences.en: The bodies of Cecilia and Victoria were beyond the threshold.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚和维多利亚的尸体就在门槛外。

sentences.en: Andreas and Celie were still positioned by the wall where Lorenz had left them.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚斯和塞莉仍然保持着洛伦兹发现他们时的姿势，靠在墙边。

sentences.en: All four had sustained fatal blows to the skull, but there was no blood spatter anywhere except on the door that led to the stables.
sentences.zh: 四人的头骨都受到了致命打击，但除了通往马厩的门上，其他地方都没有血迹喷溅。

sentences.en: Upon inspecting the pickaxe propped against the wall, Detective Reingruber noted it was clean, but took red-brown spots on the handle for bloodstains.
sentences.zh: 在检查靠在墙上的鹤嘴锄时，莱因格鲁伯侦探注意到它是干净的，但把手上的红褐色斑点误认为是血迹。

sentences.en: Lorenz informed the detective he believed this was the murder weapon and the cattle must have licked it clean.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹告诉侦探他认为这就是凶器，牛群一定把它舔干净了。

sentences.en: Investigators made their way into the kitchen, where they noticed a few blood spots on the threshold leading to the maid's room.
sentences.zh: 调查人员进入厨房，注意到通往女佣房间的门槛上有几处血迹。

sentences.en: Inside, Maria was fully dressed and lying in the fetal position on the floor, appearing as though she had been attacked before she prepared for bed.
sentences.zh: 在里面，玛丽亚穿着整齐，蜷缩在地上，看起来像是还没准备睡觉就遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: There were also some small bloodstains in the hallway leading to the family's bedrooms, but there were no bloody footprints.
sentences.zh: 通往家庭卧室的走廊里也有一些小血迹，但没有血脚印。

sentences.en: The room Victoria shared with her two children had been ransacked, with cupboard doors flung open and
sentences.zh: 维多利亚和她两个孩子共用的房间被翻得乱七八糟，橱柜门大开，

sentences.en: an empty purse, papers, a notebook and a watch strewn across her bed, but no other areas in the house showed any signs of burglary.
sentences.zh: 一个空钱包、文件、笔记本和一块手表散落在她的床上，但房子里其他区域没有入室盗窃的迹象。

sentences.en: The roof of Joseph Stroller had been torn apart by a forceful blow and the killer had used one of Victoria's skirts to conceal the boy's body.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·斯托勒的头顶被猛烈的一击撕裂，凶手用维多利亚的一条裙子遮住了男孩的尸体。

sentences.en: In the attic above the barn, investigators noticed hay had been spread across the floor and featured several impressions, as though one or more people had lain there.
sentences.zh: 在谷仓上方的阁楼里，调查人员注意到地板上铺着干草，上面有几处压痕，看起来像是一个或多个人曾躺在那里。

sentences.en: Bacon rinds, as well as human excrement, were found in the corner.
sentences.zh: 角落里发现了培根皮和人类排泄物。

sentences.en: There were also some loose tiles on the roof that could be raised slightly to view the living quarters and yard outside.
sentences.zh: 屋顶上还有一些松动的瓦片，可以稍微掀开，从而观察起居区和外面的院子。

sentences.en: As all external doors to the property had been locked from the inside, investigators wondered how the perpetrator exited the building following the murders.
sentences.zh: 由于房产的所有外门都是从内部锁上的，调查人员想知道凶手在谋杀后是如何离开建筑的。

sentences.en: Two police dogs were sent out into the woods to track down evidence, but nothing was found.
sentences.zh: 两只警犬被派往树林追踪线索，但一无所获。

sentences.en: It had rained in recent days and much of the snow that had previously covered the ground had since melted away.
sentences.zh: 最近几天下了雨，之前覆盖地面的大部分积雪已经融化。

sentences.en: Detective Reingruber noted in his report,
sentences.zh: 莱因格鲁伯侦探在报告中写道，

sentences.en: There are no tangible clues about the persons or offenders.
sentences.zh: 关于作案人员没有任何实质性线索。

sentences.en: Statements were taken from local residents, including the three men who discovered the crime scene, Lorenz Schlittenbauer, Jacob Siegel, and Michael Pell.
sentences.zh: 警方对当地居民进行了问话，包括发现犯罪现场的三名男子：洛伦兹·施利滕鲍尔、雅各布·西格尔和迈克尔·佩尔。

sentences.en: Lorenz insisted he hadn't let anyone else enter the property after finding the bodies, despite several statements to the contrary.
sentences.zh: 尽管有多份证词与之相反，洛伦兹坚称他在发现尸体后没有让任何人进入房产。

sentences.en: He claimed the family had 100,000 marks in cash stashed on the premises, yet investigators only found a five-mark bill tucked away in a prayer book.
sentences.zh: 他声称这家人在屋里藏了10万马克现金，但调查人员只在祈祷书中发现了一张5马克的钞票。

sentences.en: As such, robbery was the suspected motive for the massacre.
sentences.zh: 因此，抢劫被认为是这起屠杀的动机。

sentences.en: However, the perpetrator ignored many valuables in the home, including jewellery, watches, and more than 2,200 marks worth of gold and silver coins.
sentences.zh: 然而，凶手忽略了屋内的许多贵重物品，包括珠宝、手表以及价值超过2200马克的金银币。

sentences.en: Witness statements were used to piece together a probable timeline of events.
sentences.zh: 证人证词被用来拼凑事件发生的时间线。

sentences.en: Given Seely's absence from school on Saturday April 1, the murders were estimated to have occurred between 8pm and 11pm on
sentences.zh: 鉴于塞莉在4月1日星期六缺课，估计谋杀案发生在

sentences.en: Friday March 31.
sentences.zh: 3月31日星期五晚上8点到11点之间。

sentences.en: Experiments concluded that screaming inside the barn could not be heard in the house.
sentences.zh: 实验得出结论，在房子里听不到谷仓内的尖叫声。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the internal door leading from the house into the barn was narrow, enabling only one individual to enter at a time.
sentences.zh: 此外，从房子通往谷仓的内部通道很窄，一次只能容纳一人通过。

sentences.en: Thus, it seemed unlikely the entire family were killed at once inside the barn, as some would have had the opportunity to flee.
sentences.zh: 因此，全家人似乎不太可能同时在谷仓内被杀，因为有些人本有机会逃跑。

sentences.en: It appeared as though they were lured in one at a time.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎是被一个接一个地诱骗进去的。

sentences.en: Andreas Gruber's previous remarks to neighbours that a cow had inexplicably escaped
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚斯·格鲁伯之前曾向邻居提到有一头牛莫名其妙地逃到了

sentences.en: into the yard led investigators to presume this was the technique used to draw the family out of the house.
sentences.zh: 院子里，这让调查人员推测这是将家人引出房子的手段。

sentences.en: Given that Lorenz Schlittenbauer moved two of the bodies, the order of the killings couldn't be confirmed.
sentences.zh: 鉴于洛伦兹·施利滕鲍尔移动了两具尸体，杀人顺序无法确认。

sentences.en: Police suspected Victoria and Cecilia were the first victims, as they were both fully dressed.
sentences.zh: 警方怀疑维多利亚和塞西莉亚是第一批受害者，因为她们都穿着整齐。

sentences.en: Next was Andreas, who was in the process of changing into his nightclothes, followed by Seely, who was ready for bed.
sentences.zh: 接下来是正在换睡衣的安德烈亚斯，随后是准备睡觉的塞莉。

sentences.en: After that, the killer entered the living quarters and struck Maria from behind, before murdering Joseph.
sentences.zh: 此后，凶手进入起居区，从背后袭击了玛丽亚，然后杀害了约瑟夫。

sentences.en: The family's entire bread supply and several pieces of smoked meat were missing.
sentences.zh: 家里的面包储备和几块熏肉不见了。

sentences.en: This, coupled with witness reports that the Hinterkaifeck livestock were quiet immediately
sentences.zh: 这一点，加上证人报告称辛特凯菲克的牲畜在屠杀后立即

sentences.en: following the massacre, led to the belief that the killer remained at the property after the slaughter, possibly for several days, feeding themselves and the animals.
sentences.zh: 变得安静，导致人们认为凶手在屠杀后仍留在房产内，可能停留了几天，喂养自己和动物。

sentences.en: The delay in discovering the bodies and disruptions to the crime scene hampered forensic evidence, but the investigation was minimal regardless.
sentences.zh: 发现尸体的延迟和对犯罪现场的破坏阻碍了法医证据的收集，但无论如何，调查工作都十分有限。

sentences.en: No fingerprints were collected, even though this method had been established more than a decade earlier, and only five photographs were taken of the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 没有采集指纹，尽管这种方法在十多年前就已经确立，而且对犯罪现场只拍摄了五张照片。

sentences.en: Autopsies were conducted on the grounds of Hinterkaifeck, overseen by a crowd of onlookers.
sentences.zh: 尸检是在辛特凯菲克的场地上进行的，由一群旁观者监督。

sentences.en: A door was placed across two wooden trestles to function as a makeshift table.
sentences.zh: 一扇门被放在两个木架上，充当临时解剖台。

sentences.en: The district court doctor confirmed all six victims had died from head injuries by the blunt edge of a farmyard tool, such as a pickaxe.
sentences.zh: 地区法院医生证实，所有六名受害者都是死于农具（如鹤嘴锄）钝刃造成的头部损伤。

sentences.en: The perpetrator appeared left-handed as the majority of the wounds were inflicted on the right side of the victim's heads.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎是左撇子，因为大部分伤口都集中在受害者头部的右侧。

sentences.en: Victoria had sustained the most injuries, including markings consistent with strangulation, and nine star-shaped wounds to her skull.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚受的伤最重，包括符合勒死特征的痕迹，以及头骨上的九处星形伤口。

sentences.en: Seven-year-old Celie was the only victim who did not die instantly, enduring two to three hours of agony before finally succumbing to her injuries.
sentences.zh: 七岁的塞莉是唯一没有当场死亡的受害者，她忍受了两到三个小时的痛苦才最终伤重不治。

sentences.en: It was believed had she received immediate medical attention, she would have survived.
sentences.zh: 据信，如果她能得到及时的医疗救助，本可以活下来。

sentences.en: The heads of all six victims were sent to the Pathology Institute at the University of Munich for further examination, and their bodies remained at Hinterkaifeck to await burial.
sentences.zh: 所有六名受害者的头部被送往慕尼黑大学病理研究所进行进一步检查，尸体则留在辛特凯菲克等待安葬。

sentences.en: As two officers carried Celie's body inside the barn, they noticed a rope hanging down from the loft above which had not been there moments earlier.
sentences.zh: 当两名警官将塞莉的尸体抬进谷仓时，他们注意到阁楼上垂下一根绳子，刚才还没有。

sentences.en: They climbed up and sighted handprints on the dusty beam the rope was tied to.
sentences.zh: 他们爬上去，在绳子系着的布满灰尘的横梁上看到了手印。

sentences.en: Police dogs were dispatched in an attempt to capture whoever had been hiding above, but no trace of the individual was found.
sentences.zh: 警方派出警犬试图抓捕躲在上面的人，但没有发现任何踪迹。

sentences.en: The funerals for the Hinterkaifeck household were scheduled for Saturday April 8.
sentences.zh: 辛特凯菲克一家的葬礼定于4月8日星期六举行。

sentences.en: Word incorrectly spread that the service was taking place on April 7, resulting in an influx of visitors to the area a day early.
sentences.zh: 有传言错误地称仪式在4月7日举行，导致大量访客提前一天涌入该地区。

sentences.en: They planned to use the extra time to examine the site of the murders, only to find that police had cordoned off the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 他们计划利用额外的时间检查谋杀现场，却发现警方已经封锁了犯罪现场。

sentences.en: The following morning, Weidhofen's Catholic Church struggled to accommodate the approximately 3,000 mourners who had gathered.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，魏德霍芬天主教堂难以容纳聚集而来的约3000名哀悼者。

sentences.en: The six matching coffins were carried to the church on a wagon.
sentences.zh: 六口相同的棺材被马车运往教堂。

sentences.en: Father Michael Haas told the congregation that God viewed murder as a terrible abomination, and only a man with no spark of faith in his heart could commit such a horrific act.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·哈斯神父告诉会众，上帝视谋杀为可怕的罪恶，只有心中毫无信仰火花的人才会做出如此残忍的行为。

sentences.en: The five members of the Gruber-Gabriel family and Maria Baumgartner were buried together in a mass grave, with the adults' coffins flanking the children's tiny caskets.
sentences.zh: 格鲁伯-加布里埃尔一家的五名成员和玛丽亚·鲍姆加特纳被合葬在一个集体墓穴中，成年人的棺材簇拥着孩子的小棺材。

sentences.en: Police announced a reward of 100,000 marks for information about the killer's identity.
sentences.zh: 警方宣布悬赏10万马克征集有关凶手身份的信息。

sentences.en: The amount was soon increased to 500,000 marks, and posters were distributed throughout the region to publicise the investigation.
sentences.zh: 赏金很快增加到50万马克，海报在全地区分发以宣传调查。

sentences.en: The murders had shocked and terrified the local community and made newspaper headlines across the country.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案震惊并恐吓了当地社区，并登上了全国各地的报纸头条。

sentences.en: Fearful citizens began reporting their friends, neighbours, and other individuals who they deemed suspicious.
sentences.zh: 恐惧的市民开始举报他们认为可疑的朋友、邻居和其他人。

sentences.en: Rural residents were advised to be vigilant, especially at night, and to thoroughly search their properties each evening.
sentences.zh: 农村居民被建议保持警惕，尤其是在晚上，并每天晚上彻底搜查自己的房产。

sentences.en: They were also encouraged to keep large guard dogs for protection, look out for their neighbours, and avoid storing valuables or large sums of money in their homes.
sentences.zh: 他们还被鼓励饲养大型护卫犬以求自保，照看邻居，并避免在家中存放贵重物品或大量现金。

sentences.en: Tales of the strange events at Hinterkaifeck preceding the massacre spread, and several more bizarre incidents were reported.
sentences.zh: 关于辛特凯菲克在屠杀前发生的奇怪事件的传闻四起，更多离奇事件被报道出来。

sentences.en: Two weeks before the murders, Father Haas supposedly found an anonymous donation of 700 gold marks in his church, which he suspected had been left by Victoria Gabriel.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生前两周，哈斯神父据称在教堂里发现了一笔700金马克的匿名捐款，他怀疑是维多利亚·加布里埃尔留下的。

sentences.en: When he queried her about it, she reluctantly admitted to making the sizable donation.
sentences.zh: 当他询问她时，她勉强承认了这笔巨额捐款。

sentences.en: A local carpenter reported that on Saturday April 1, he walked past Hinterkaifeck at around 11.30pm, more than 24 hours after the murders were believed to have taken place.
sentences.zh: 一位当地木匠报告说，4月1日星期六晚上11点30分左右，他路过辛特凯菲克，这距离谋杀案发生的时间已经超过24小时。

sentences.en: He saw a light shining from the oven inside the farmstead, and a curl of smoke coming from the chimney.
sentences.zh: 他看到农舍里的烤箱透出光亮，烟囱里冒出一缕烟。

sentences.en: He then noticed a figure holding a flashlight moving about in the yard.
sentences.zh: 然后他注意到一个拿着手电筒的人影在院子里走动。

sentences.en: The figure began to approach, shining the light in his eyes.
sentences.zh: 那个人影开始靠近，并用灯光照向他的眼睛。

sentences.en: Somewhat spooked, the carpenter hurried home without stopping.
sentences.zh: 木匠有些害怕，没敢停留，匆忙赶回家。

sentences.en: In addition to robbery, other motives were also considered.
sentences.zh: 除了抢劫，其他动机也被考虑在内。

sentences.en: The strangulation marks on Victoria hinted at it being a personal attack, and some speculated the murderer could be a scorned lover.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚身上的勒痕暗示这是一起个人袭击，一些人推测凶手可能是被抛弃的情人。

sentences.en: Others believed the killings were a form of retribution for Andreas and Victoria's incestuous relationship.
sentences.zh: 另一些人认为谋杀是对安德烈亚斯和维多利亚乱伦关系的报复。

sentences.en: Following the murders, victims' relatives embarked on a legal battle over ownership of Hinterkaifeck.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生后，受害者的亲属就辛特凯菲克的归属权展开了法律斗争。

sentences.en: As Seely was the last to die, she had been the farm's sole owner for a brief period.
sentences.zh: 由于塞莉是最后一个去世的，她在短暂的时间里曾是农场的唯一所有者。

sentences.en: Therefore, the Gabriel side of the family believed possession of the property should pass to her paternal grandparents.
sentences.zh: 因此，加布里埃尔家族认为该房产的拥有权应转交给她的父系祖父母。

sentences.en: The matter was resolved out of court, with the Gabriels purchasing Hinterkaifeck from the Grubers for 3 million marks.
sentences.zh: 此事在庭外解决，加布里埃尔家族以300万马克从格鲁伯家族手中买下了辛特凯菲克。

sentences.en: In late February 1923, they decided to demolish the entire property.
sentences.zh: 1923年2月下旬，他们决定拆除整个房产。

sentences.en: They commissioned an artist to paint a watercolour picture of the property beforehand, capturing the white farmhouse in a field of green, framed by budding trees.
sentences.zh: 他们在此之前委托一位艺术家画了一幅房产的水彩画，捕捉了绿地中白色的农舍，周围环绕着含苞待放的树木。

sentences.en: The next day, carpenters dismantling the roof trusses noticed several loose floorboards in the attic next to the staircase.
sentences.zh: 第二天，拆除屋顶桁架的木匠注意到楼梯旁阁楼的几块地板松动了。

sentences.en: They pried them up, revealing a small nest of hay underneath, along with a blood-stained mattock, a hand tool commonly used for clearing small trees and shrubs.
sentences.zh: 他们撬开地板，在下面发现了一个干草窝，还有一把沾满血迹的鹤嘴锄，这是一种常用于清理小树和灌木的手工工具。

sentences.en: It had a blunt horizontal axe head and a long wooden handle.
sentences.zh: 它有一个钝的水平斧头和长木柄。

sentences.en: Alongside it was a small metal hoop coated in dried blood.
sentences.zh: 旁边是一个沾满干血的金属圈。

sentences.en: The tool had previously belonged to Andreas Gruber, as neighbours recognised the distinctive screw protruding from the handle that he had fitted during repairs.
sentences.zh: 该工具曾属于安德烈亚斯·格鲁伯，因为邻居们认出了他在修理时安装在手柄上的那个独特的突出螺丝。

sentences.en: The screw perfectly matched the star-shaped injuries to Victoria's skull, and police declared the mattock as the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 螺丝与维多利亚头骨上的星形伤口完全吻合，警方宣布鹤嘴锄为凶器。

sentences.en: Several days later, while clearing out the barn, excavators found a bloody penknife close to where the bodies had been found.
sentences.zh: 几天后，在清理谷仓时，挖掘人员在发现尸体的地方附近找到了一把带血的折叠刀。

sentences.en: Maintaining they had conducted a thorough search of the crime scene, investigators believed the killer returned to the farm to hide the mattock and penknife once the heat
sentences.zh: 调查人员坚称他们已经对犯罪现场进行了彻底搜查，认为凶手在调查风头过后回到了农场，藏起了鹤嘴锄和折叠刀。

sentences.en: of the investigation had died down.
sentences.zh: 调查热度平息后。

sentences.en: No fingerprints were recovered from either item.
sentences.zh: 两件物品上都没有提取到指纹。

sentences.en: Given the social and cultural climate climate of Bavaria at the time, political motivations for the murders were also considered.
sentences.zh: 鉴于当时巴伐利亚的社会和文化氛围，谋杀案的政治动机也被考虑在内。

sentences.en: The region was a hotbed for paramilitary organisations and extremist groups,
sentences.zh: 该地区是准军事组织和极端主义团体的温床，

sentences.en: and it was theorised that Andreas Gruber had belonged to one, and either embezzled funds or committed treason.
sentences.zh: 有人推测安德烈亚斯·格鲁伯曾属于其中一个组织，要么挪用了资金，要么犯了叛国罪。

sentences.en: Investigators sought to question an individual associated with one such extremist group, 33-year-old former soldier Adolf Gump.
sentences.zh: 调查人员试图审问与其中一个极端组织有关联的人，33岁的前士兵阿道夫·冈普。

sentences.en: After World War I, Gump joined a Bavarian paramilitary faction and eventually formed a commando unit within the group.
sentences.zh: 第一次世界大战后，冈普加入了巴伐利亚的一个准军事派系，并最终在该组织内组建了一支突击队。

sentences.en: In 1921, he participated in the massacre of nine farmers, which he often boasted about.
sentences.zh: 1921年，他参与了九名农民的屠杀，他经常以此为荣。

sentences.en: Unsubstantiated rumours accused Gump of having been romantically involved with Victoria Gabriel.
sentences.zh: 未经证实的传言指控冈普曾与维多利亚·加布里埃尔有染。

sentences.en: However, he could not be found.
sentences.zh: 然而，他一直下落不明。

sentences.en: Three weeks into the investigation, police in Munich received a letter requesting they look into Carl Gabriel, Victoria's former husband.
sentences.zh: 调查进行三周后，慕尼黑警方收到一封信，要求他们调查维多利亚的前夫卡尔·加布里埃尔。

sentences.en: Carl had been reportedly killed in action during the war eight years earlier, yet his body was never returned to Germany, and stories
sentences.zh: 据报道，卡尔八年前在战争中阵亡，但他的尸体从未被送回德国，而且流传着

sentences.en: circulated of soldiers who faked their death to live under assumed identities.
sentences.zh: 士兵伪造死亡以隐姓埋名生活的故事。

sentences.en: The theory was that Carl had done exactly that, but upon learning of the incestuous relationship between Victoria and Andreas,
sentences.zh: 理论是卡尔确实这样做了，但在得知维多利亚和安德烈亚斯之间的乱伦关系后，

sentences.en: returned to Hinterkaifeck to murder the entire family.
sentences.zh: 回到辛特凯菲克杀害了全家。

sentences.en: Police spoke with several of Carl's fellow officers, who confirmed they had seen his body after his death and revealed he was buried in a war cemetery in France.
sentences.zh: 警方与卡尔的几位战友谈过，他们证实在他死后见过他的尸体，并透露他被埋葬在法国的一个战争公墓。

sentences.en: Other theories centred on Carl's family, that they carried out the murders for financial gain or revenge for their son's unhappy marriage.
sentences.zh: 其他理论集中在卡尔的家人身上，认为他们为了经济利益或为儿子不幸的婚姻报仇而实施了谋杀。

sentences.en: Several locals expressed suspicion towards brothers Carl and Anton Bickler, well-known thieves who had worked at Hinterkaifeck during the harvest seasons.
sentences.zh: 几位当地人对卡尔和安东·比克勒兄弟表示怀疑，他们是众所周知的窃贼，曾在收获季节在辛特凯菲克工作过。

sentences.en: One witness claimed Carl
sentences.zh: 一位证人声称卡尔

sentences.en: Bickler had proposed the idea of robbing Hinterkaifeck, while another noticed the brothers had recently been spending a significant amount of money, despite being unemployed.
sentences.zh: 比克勒曾提议抢劫辛特凯菲克，而另一位证人注意到这两兄弟最近尽管失业，却花了一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Hinterkaifeck's former maid,
sentences.zh: 辛特凯菲克的前女佣，

sentences.en: Crescenz Riga, explained that the brothers were familiar with the layout of the property, and Anton was one of the few people whom the family dog never barked at.
sentences.zh: 克雷森茨·里加解释说，这两兄弟熟悉房产的布局，而且安东是少数几个家里的狗从不冲其吠叫的人之一。

sentences.en: According to Crescenz,
sentences.zh: 据克雷森茨说，

sentences.en: Anton once remarked that the family needed to be killed.
sentences.zh: 安东曾评论说这家人需要被杀掉。

sentences.en: When she informed her employers of his comment, they dismissed the threat.
sentences.zh: 当她把他的评论告诉雇主时，他们并没有把威胁当回事。

sentences.en: This incident prompted Crescenz to quit as she feared the Bickler brothers were planning an attack.
sentences.zh: 这件事促使克雷森茨辞职，因为她担心比克勒兄弟正在策划袭击。

sentences.en: Carl Bickler was taken in for questioning, during which he professed his innocence and was able to provide an alibi for himself and Anton.
sentences.zh: 卡尔·比克勒被带去问话，期间他坚称自己无罪，并能为自己和安东提供不在场证明。

sentences.en: The brothers had been drinking in a bar 51 kilometres south of Hinterkaifeck at the time of the murders.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生时，两兄弟正在距离辛特凯菲克以南51公里的一家酒吧喝酒。

sentences.en: Months later, on August 2, the mother of another set of brothers, Carl and Andreas Schreier, confessed to a neighbour that her sons were responsible for the crime.
sentences.zh: 几个月后的8月2日，另一对兄弟卡尔和安德烈亚斯·施赖尔的母亲向邻居承认，她的儿子们应对这起罪行负责。

sentences.en: The Schreier brothers were arrested and a hearing took place the following month, but both men were released due to a lack of evidence.
sentences.zh: 施赖尔兄弟被捕，次月举行了听证会，但两人因证据不足而被释放。

sentences.en: Other suspects included a former soldier who had escaped from a Bavarian mental health hospital a year before the murders.
sentences.zh: 其他嫌疑人包括一名在谋杀案发生前一年从巴伐利亚精神病院逃出的前士兵。

sentences.en: He was believed to have burgled properties in the vicinity of Hinterkaifeck, though there was no evidence linking him to the farm, and his whereabouts remained unknown.
sentences.zh: 人们认为他曾在欣特凯费克附近入室行窃，尽管没有证据将他与该农场联系起来，且他的下落至今不明。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商内容，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Suspicions were also cast on Lorenz Schlittenbauer, the neighbour who discovered the bodies at Hinterkaifeck.
sentences.zh: 邻居洛伦兹·施利滕鲍尔也受到了怀疑，正是他发现了欣特凯费克的尸体。

sentences.en: Lorenz had resided in the same farmhouse on the fringe of Grauben his entire life.
sentences.zh: 洛伦兹一生都住在格劳本边缘的同一座农舍里。

sentences.en: He also served as the village guide, collaborating with the local council and acting as a spokesperson for the community.
